Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Charge Into Danger
Cards.Text: Battle: Choose your performing Personality: If he assigned to, or would be opposed at, the current battlefield, move him there. If his base Force is 7 or higher, straighten him.

Cards.Name: Consuming Weakness
Cards.Text: Fear Battle: Target your performing Shadowlands Personality and remove a target dead Personality in any discard pile from the game to give your Personality +3F, or +4F if he is Undead.

Cards.Name: Fires of Turmoil
Cards.Text: Battle: Discard the top card of a Fate deck. Target a card without attachments. If the discarded card's Focus Value is odd, bow the target (0 is even). Otherwise, straighten it. Move its unit home if the target has a Madness token.

Cards.Name: Gripped by Terror
Cards.Text: Battle: Choose your performing Personality and target an enemy Personality or Follower: Give it -4F. If your Personality is Nonhuman, give each of your Personalities at the current battlefield +1F.

Cards.Name: Outnumbered
Cards.Text: Battle: Give all your opposed Personalities with Followers at the current battlefield +1F. Give all enemy Personalities there without Followers -1F.

Cards.Name: Preserving Honor
Cards.Text: Battle: Target an enemy Personality at the current battlefield: His controller chooses either to bow him, or to choose another location and move him there. If the bowing or movement is negated, remove the Personality from the game.

Cards.Name: Your Clan Needs You!
Cards.Text: Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield, choose your performing Personality in one of your provinces: Bring him into play at the current battlefield, paying all costs but paying 6 less Gold. After the battle ends, if he is in play, discard all his attachments and put him into one of your provinces, face-up, discarding any card there.
